statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations
The patient presents with episodes of dizziness and giddiness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial evaluation
A Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring study (CPT 93229) was ordered
The study is for continuous ambulatory monitoring
The diagnosis codes are R00.2 and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
